## Line 294

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato, line 294](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato#L294).

```plato

    // On the bisector, at 2/3 * r * sin(alpha)/alpha from the circle's centre,
    // where alpha is the HALF angle — written here with theta = 2*alpha as
    // 4*r*sin(theta/2) / (3*theta). Degenerates to the centre for a zero sweep.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_sector#Centroid
    Centroid(s: CircularSector): Point2D
    {
        var theta = s.Sweep.Extent;
        var distance = theta.Radians == 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : 4.0 * s.Circle.Radius * (theta * 0.5).Sin / (3.0 * theta.Radians);
        return s.Circle.Center + SweepBisector(s.Sweep) * distance;
    }
```

## Line 352

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato, line 352](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato#L352).

```plato

    // On the bisector, at 4*r*sin^3(theta/2) / (3*(theta - sin theta)) from the
    // circle's centre. Checks out against the standard semicircle result 4r/(3pi)
    // at theta = pi. Degenerate (division by zero) as theta approaches 0, where the
    // segment itself vanishes. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_segment
    Centroid(s: CircularSegment): Point2D
    {
        var theta = s.Sweep.Extent;
        var halfSin = (theta * 0.5).Sin;
        var denominator = 3.0 * (theta.Radians - theta.Sin);
        var distance = denominator == 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : 4.0 * s.Circle.Radius * halfSin * halfSin * halfSin / denominator;
        return s.Circle.Center + SweepBisector(s.Sweep) * distance;
    }
```

    // The arithmetic mean of the three vertices, which for a triangle is also its
    // area centroid. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centroid#Of_a_triangle
    Centroid(t: Triangle2D): Point2D
        => ((t.A.X + t.B.X + t.C.X) / 3.0, (t.A.Y + t.B.Y + t.C.Y) / 3.0);
```

    // The area centroid of the quadrilateral — NOT the average of its four
    // vertices, which is a different point for any non-parallelogram.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centroid#Of_a_polygon
    Centroid(q: Quad2D): Point2D
        => q.Points.PolygonAreaCentroid;
```

    // The intersection of the diagonals: Origin displaced by half of each side.
    Centroid(g: Parallelogram2D): Point2D
        => g.Origin + (g.SideA + g.SideB) * 0.5;
